info.name: VTex Anti-fraud Provider Account Fulfillment API
VTex List pickup points by location

params.name: geoCoordinates
params.description: Geocoordinates (first longitude, then latitude) around which to search for pickup points. If you use this type of search, do not pass postal and country codes.

params.name: postalCode
params.description: Postal code around which to search for pickup points. If you use this type of search, make sure to pass a `countryCode` and do not pass `geoCoordinates`.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Three letter country code refering to the `postalCode` field. Pass the country code only if you are searching pickup points by postal code.

items.docs:
Retrieves information on pickup points close to a given location determined by geocoordinates or postal code.

The pickup points returned are not necessarily all active ones. Make sure to validate the information consumed by integrations.

## Permissions

This endpoint does not require [permissions](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/license-manager-resources--3q6ztrC8YynQf6rdc6euk3).

info.name: VTex Get address by postal code

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Three letter country code refering to the `postalCode` field.

items.docs:
Retrieves address information for a given postal code and country.

This request can be used to implement auto complete functionality when a customer needs to fill in an address.

## Permissions

This endpoint does not require [permissions](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/license-manager-resources--3q6ztrC8YynQf6rdc6euk3).
